straw.definition:
n. plant fiber used e.g. for making baskets and hats or as fodder
n. a thin paper or plastic tube used to suck liquids into the mouth
v. cover or provide with or as if with straw
s. of a pale yellow color like straw; straw-colored
straw.translation:
n. 稻草, 麦管, 吸管, 一文不值的东西, 草帽

straw boss.translation: <美口>工地组长, 工头助手

straw-colored.definition: s having the color of dry straw

straw-coloured.definition: s having the color of dry straw

n. sweet fleshy red fruit

n. a soft red birthmark

straws.definition:
n plant fiber used e.g. for making baskets and hats or as fodder
n material consisting of seed coverings and small pieces of stem or leaves that have been separated from the seeds
n a variable yellow tint; dull yellow, often diluted with white
n a thin paper or plastic tube used to suck liquids into the mouth
v cover or provide with or as if with straw
v spread by scattering ("straw" is archaic)
straws.translation: n. 稻草( straw的名词复数 ); 麦秆; 吸管; 毫无价值的东西

strawworm.definition:
n larva of the caddis fly; constructs a case of silk covered with sand or plant debris
n larva of chalcid flies injurious to the straw of wheat and other grains

strawy.definition: a. Of or pertaining to straw; made of, or resembling, straw.
